Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of META.
We delivered record revenue of $20.6 billion this quarter, representing 9% year-over-year growth.
Revenue guidance of $20.6 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2023.
Our gross margin expanded by 192 basis points to 40.3%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. We generated $16.5 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 192 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
